newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African police say serial killer smart, suave.
newsitem.headline: S.African police say serial killer smart, suave.

text.p: South African police on Friday described the country's latest serial killer as an intelligent misogynist with an eye for fashion.
Police forensic psychologist Micki Pistorius issued a character sketch of the man who has killed at least 14 women.
"The killer is intelligent and he is well dressed. He is very convincing but manipulates people easily. One would not suspect that he is a serial killer," Pistorius said.

The "Nasrec murderer", named after the city's exhibition centre area where the bodies of several victims have been discovered, is the sixth serial killer to emerge in two years in a country plagued by violent crime.
"He has a deep-seated hatred of women and demands submissiveness from them," Pistorius said in the statement.
He said the killer's victims were black women between the ages of 20 and 35, "but any woman could be considered a potential victim."
Mass murder suspect Moses Sithole, accused of killing more than 30 women in South Africa, goes on trial next month.
